data.titulo: Babg 5—Israɛll nebã yembdã Babilonnã, n tãag Zerizalɛm lalsã meebo
data.contenido:
Israɛll nebã sẽn da yaa yembs n be Babilonnã, b paama zu-​loees wʋsgo, b sẽn da tũud Wẽnnaamã yĩnga. B loba a Sadrak, a Mesak la a Abɛdnego bugum pʋgẽ, la Wẽnnaam fãag-⁠b lame. Meed ne Pɛrs rãmbã sẽn wa n zab n deeg Babilonnã poore, b loba a Daniɛll gɩgma bokẽ, la Wẽnnaam muma gɩgma wã noy tɩ b ka wãb-⁠a ye.

Israɛll nebã sẽn kẽng yembd Babilonnã yʋʋm 70 poore, Pɛrs naab a Sirus wa n yiis-⁠b-⁠la yembdã n bas-⁠b tɩ b leb b ba-​yirã. B sẽn ta Zerizalɛmmã, pipi b reng n sɩngame n na n me a Zeova roogã. La pa yã n kaoos la bɛɛb wa n na n gɩdg-⁠b ye. Kɩtame tɩ b sẽn leb Zerizalɛmmã, maana yʋʋm 22 tɩ b yaool n na n tõog n me wẽnd-​doogã n sa.

Rẽ poore, a Ɛsdras na n wa kẽnga Zerizalɛm n tɩ maneg wẽnd-​doogã. Yaa wẽnd-​doogã sẽn me n sa tɩ yʋʋm 47 la a Ɛsdras na n maan dẽ. Yʋʋm 13 rẽ poore, a Nehemi tɩ sõngame n lebs n me Zerizalɛm lalsã sẽn da lʋɩyã. Dẽnd babg a nu wã gomda yɛl sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm koabg la pis-⁠nu la a yiib pʋgẽ.

data.titulo: B ka sak n wõgemd ye
data.contenido:
YÃMB ket n tẽra a Daniɛll zo-​rãmb a tãab nins sẽn da naag-⁠a n zãgs tɩ b kõn dɩ na-​yirã rɩɩbã yell bɩ? Babilon nebã pʋd-⁠b lame t’a Sadrak, a Mesak la a Abɛdnego. Ges-⁠y foto wã. B pa sak n na n wõgemd bõn-​naandg ning sẽn yaa wokã taoor wa neb a taabã ye. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa bũmb ning yĩng bɩ? D karem tɩ d na bãnge.

Yãmb ket n tẽrã noy piig nins a Zeova sẽn da gʋlsã yell bɩ? Pipi noorã yeta woto: ‘Ra pʋʋs wẽnnaam dãmb a taab ye, sã n ka maam bala.’ Yaa a Sadrak, a Mesak la a Abɛdnego sẽn dat n sak no-​kãngã wã yĩng la b sẽn pa wõgemdã. B tũu no-​kãngã, baa ne a tũubã sẽn da pa nana wã.

Babilon naab a Nebukadnezaar boola tẽngã nin-​kãsemsã fãa tɩ b wa wõgemd n pʋʋs bõn-​naandg ning a sẽn kɩt tɩ b maanã. A yeela nebã yaa: ‘Yãmb sã n wʋm bard la wɩɩs peebgo, la kʋn ne pendes la ruuds wẽebo, ne tõn-​tõog peebg la yʋʋm teed buud fãa rãamde, bɩ y wõgemd n waoog sãnem bõn-​naandgã. La ned ninga sẽn ka sak n wõgemd n pʋʋs-⁠a, b na n lob-⁠a-⁠la wʋng sẽn wɩng wʋsg pʋgẽ.’ Nebã fãa sakame la a Sadrak, a Mesak ne a Abɛdnego pa sak ye.

B sẽn wa n yeel naab a Nebukadnezaar t’a Sadrak, a Mesak la a Abɛdnego pa sak n wõgemdã, a sũurã yika wʋsg ne-⁠ba. A kɩtame tɩ b tall-⁠b n wa yẽ taoore. A pa sɩbg-⁠b zĩig pʋgẽ ye. A yeel-⁠b lame tɩ b lebg n kẽng n tɩ wõgemd tɩ nan ket n maasa. La kom-​bɩɩs a tãabã teega a Zeova. B yeela a Nebukadnezaar yaa: ‘Tõnd Wẽnnaamã tõnd sẽn waoogdã na n fãaga tõndo. La baa a sã n ka fãag-⁠do, bɩ y bãng tɩ tõnd ka na n wõgemd sãnem bõn-​naandg ningã yãmb sẽn luglã taoor ye.’

A Nebukadnezaar sẽn wʋm gom-​kãensã wã, a sũurã maneg n puugame n paase. Wʋng n da pẽ be t’a yeel tɩ b wɩng wʋngã naoor a yopoe n yɩɩd b sẽn da mi n wɩngd-⁠a to-⁠to wã. Rẽ poore, a kɩtame tɩ sodaas sẽn tar pãng wʋsg sẽb a Sadrak, a Mesak la a Abɛdnego n lob wʋngã pʋgẽ. La wʋngã ra wɩnga wʋsg hal tɩ bugmã walem kʋ sodaasã. La bõe n paam a Sadrak ne a Mesak la a Abɛdnego, b sẽn lob-⁠b bugmã pʋgẽ wã?

Rĩmã gesa wʋngã pʋgẽ, la a sẽn yã bũmb ningã yɛɛs-⁠a-⁠la wʋsgo. A soka nebã yaa: ‘Ka neb a tãab la tõnd sẽn sẽb n lob bugmẽ wã wɛ?’

Tɩ nebã leok tɩ n-⁠ye.

La a yeelame yaa: ‘Mam nee neb a naas sẽn kẽnd bugmã pʋgẽ, tɩ bũmb ka sẽb-⁠ba, la bugmã me ka rɩt-⁠b ye. La naas-⁠n-​soabã wẽnda malɛka.’ Rĩmã kolga wʋngã noor n yeel yaa: ‘Sadrak, Mesak, Abɛdnego! Yãmb yaa Wẽnnaam sẽn ka to wã sõgen dãmba. Yi-⁠y n wa-⁠y ka.’

A Sadrak ne a Mesak la a Abɛdnego yii bugmã pʋgẽ, la nebã fãa yãame tɩ baa fʋɩ ka maan-⁠b ye. Rĩmã yeelame yaa: ‘Bɩ a Sadrak ne a Mesak la a Abɛdnego Wẽnnaamã paam pẽgre. A tʋma a malɛkã t’a wa fãag-⁠ba, bala b ka sak n wõgemd n waoog wẽnnaam a to tɩ ka bãmb Wẽnnaamã ye.’

Kiba-​kãngã wilgdame tɩ d segd n saka a Zeova wakat fãa.Yikri 20:⁠3; Daniɛll 3:​1-⁠30. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y-​YÃ! Bõe la nebã sẽn maand foto wã zugã? Yaa kibs kãseng tɩ nebã rɩtẽ la b yũuda. Babilon rĩmã boola tẽngã nin-​bɛdã bãmb tusr tɩ b wa kibsã. B rɩka sãnem ne wanzuri laas nins b sẽn da wʋk Zerizalɛm, a Zeova roogã pʋgẽ wã n wa tɩ nebã tar n yũud rãam. La nug n wa n puk n gʋlsd lalgã zugu, tɩ nebã fãa yɛɛs wʋsgo.

A Bɛlsazaar yaa a Nebukadnezaar yagenga. Yaa yẽ la Babilon rĩmã masã. A kɩtame tɩ b bool a bãngdbã t’a yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Ned ninga sẽn na n tõog n karem gʋlsmã la a wilg a võore, m na n kõo a soab kũun la m kõ-a naam t’a lebg tãab-⁠n-​soab soolmã pʋgẽ.’ La bãngdbã baa a ye ra pa tõe n karem gʋlsmã meng tɩ pa sokd a võor wilgr ye.

La rĩmã ma wʋma rĩmã ne a nin-​kãsemsã goamã n kẽ kibsã roogẽ wã n yeel rĩmã yaa: ‘Ra yɛɛs ye. Rao a ye n be fo soolmã pʋgẽ n tar Wẽnnaam sẽn yaa sõngã sɩɩga. F yaab-​raoog a Nebukadnezaar kɩtame t’a lebg yam dãmbã naaba. A yʋʋr la a Daniɛlle. Kɩt tɩ b bool-⁠a t’a wa wilg gʋlsmã võor n kõ-fo.’

Tao-​tao bala, b talla a Daniɛll n wa rĩmã taoore. A Daniɛll yeelame t’a na n togsa gʋlsmã võore, la a pa na n deeg kũunã ye. A reng n wilga bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Zeova sik a Bɛlsazaar yaab-​raoog a Nebukadnezaar naamẽ wã. A yeelame tɩ yaa a Nebukadnezaar sẽn da yaa wuk-⁠m-​meng soabã yĩng la a Zeova sẽn sɩbg-⁠a wã.

A Daniɛll yeela a Bɛlsazaar yaa: ‘Yãmb bãngã rẽ fãa la y ket n ka sik y meng ye. Yãmb kɩtame tɩ b rɩk a Zeova roogã laas n wa tɩ yãmb tall n yũ y rãam. Yãmb pẽga y wẽnnaam dãmbã sẽn maan ne raad la kugã, n ka waoog Wẽnnaam ning sẽn so y vɩɩmã ye. Yaa woto yĩng la Wẽnnaam tʋm nug t’a puk n gʋls gʋlsmã.’ A paasame yaa: ‘Ad gʋlsem ning sẽn gʋlsã: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, la PARSIN.’

‘MENE rat n yeelame tɩ Wẽnnaam sõda y rĩungã rasem sõore, la a yãka a tɛka. TEKEL rat n yeelame tɩ b maka yãmb ne kɩlo n mik tɩ y yaa faasga. PARSIN rat n yeelame tɩ b pʋɩya y soolmã n kõ Meed ne Pɛrs nebã.’

A Daniɛll sẽn da wa n gomdã meng tɩ Meed ne Pɛrs nebã ra zoe n waame n sɩng zabr ne Babilon nebã. B zabame n deeg tẽngã la b kʋ a Bɛlsazaare. Yaa yʋn-​kãng bal la gʋlsmã sẽn yeel bũmb ningã paam pidsgu. La bõe n na n paam Israɛll nebã masã? D na n wa yãa rẽ, la nananda, bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn paam a Daniɛlle.Daniɛll 5:​1-⁠6:⁠131 in NW. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

KAETO, a Daniɛll bee gɩgma bokẽ! Yaa ãnd n lob a Daniɛll gɩgma kãensã fãa sʋka? Gɩgma wã yaool n pa maand a Daniɛll bũmb ye! Yãmb mii sẽn yaa bũmb ning yĩng bɩ? Bɩ d gese.

Wakat kãng tɩ ra yaa a Darius n dɩt naam Babilon. A ra nonga a Daniɛll wʋsgo, bala a Daniɛll ra yaa nin-​sõng la ned sẽn tar yam. A Darius yãka a Daniɛll t’a yɩ a kug-​zĩidbã taoor soaba. Woto kɩtame tɩ sũ-kiir yõk kug-​zĩidb a taabã, tɩ b sɩɩg taab noor n na n maan a Daniɛll wẽnga.

B kẽnga a Darius nengẽ n tɩ yeel yaa: ‘Tõnd tagsdame tɩ yaa sõma tɩ y yiis noor n wilg tɩ ned sã n pʋʋs Wẽnnaam bɩ ninsaal tɩ ka yãmb rasem 30 pʋgẽ, bɩ b lob-⁠a gɩgma wã bokẽ.’ A Darius ra pa mi bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ nin-​kãensã rat tɩ b yiis no-​kãngã wã ye. La a ra tagsdame tɩ yaa bõn-​sõngo, t’a kɩt tɩ b gʋls noorã. La b sẽn yiis noorã n sa wã, b ra pa le tõe n toeem-⁠a ye.

A Daniɛll sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a kẽe a roogã pʋgẽ n pʋʋs wa a sẽn da nong n maand daar fãa wã. Nin-​wẽn-​kãensã ra miime t’a Daniɛll pa na n bas n ka pʋʋs a Zeova ye. B sũurã yɩɩ noogo, bala b tẽedame tɩ b sẽn maan sɩlem ning n na n kʋ a Daniɛllã na n tõogame.

Rĩm a Darius sẽn wa n bãng bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ nebã da rat tɩ b yiis noorã, a sũurã sãama wʋsgo. La a sẽn da pa tõe n toeem noorã yĩnga, a kɩtame tɩ b lob a Daniɛll gɩgma wã bokẽ. La a yeela a Daniɛll yaa: ‘Bɩ fo Wẽnnaamã fo sẽn waoogd daar fãa wã fãag-⁠fo.’ A Darius sũurã sãama wʋsg t’a pa tõog n gũs baraar yʋngã ye. Vẽkembeoogã, a wudgame n kẽng gɩgma wã bokẽ. Yãmb pa ne a sẽn lɩkd sɩda? A zẽka a koɛɛg n yeel yaa: ‘Wẽnnaam sẽn vɩ tʋm-​tʋmd a Daniɛlle, fo Wẽnnaamã fo sẽn waoogd daar fãa wã tõog n fãaga foom ne gɩgma wã bɩ?’

La a Daniɛll leoka rĩmã yaa: ‘Mam Wẽnnaamã tʋma a malɛk t’a wa mum gɩgma wã noyã tɩ b ka maan maam bũmb ye.’

Rĩmã sũur yɩɩ noog wʋsgo. A yeelame tɩ b yiis a Daniɛll gɩgma wã bokẽ, la a kɩt tɩ b lob neb nins sẽn da rat n kʋ a Daniɛllã be. La b sẽn lob-⁠b bokã pʋgẽ wã, b ka yã n ta tẽng meng la gɩgma wã zoe n kok-⁠b n kao b kõabã fãa ye.

Rẽ poore, rĩm a Darius kɩtame tɩ b gʋls sebr n yeel a nin-​buiidã woto: ‘Mam kõo noor tɩ nebã fãa zoe a Daniɛll Wẽnnaamã. Wẽnnaam kãng maanda bõn-​bãn ne tʋʋm-​kãsemse. Yaa yẽ n fãag a Daniɛll tɩ gɩgma wã pa wãb-⁠a ye.’Daniɛll 6:​2-​29. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YAA sẽn kolg yʋʋm a yiib masã la Meed ne Pɛrs nebã sẽn wa n zab n deeg Babilonnã. La ges-⁠y-​yã! Israɛll nebã yita Babilon. B maana wãn n paam b mense? Yaa ãnd n bas-⁠b tɩ b loogdẽ?

Yaa Pɛrs naab a Sirus n kõ-b sore. A Zeova ra kɩtame t’a no-​rɛɛs a Ezai togs a Sirus sẽn na n wa maanã t’a nan pa rog meng ye. A Ezai gʋlsa woto: ‘Fo na n maana mam sẽn datã. Kʋɩlensã na n pakame tɩ f tõog n kẽ n deeg tẽngã.’ A Sirus sɩd waa ne a sodaasã n wa reeg Babilon ne yʋngo. Rig-​noyã sẽn da pakã yĩnga, Meed ne Pɛrs nebã tũu be n kẽ tẽngã pʋgẽ.

A Zeova no-​rɛɛs a Ezai ra yeelame me t’a Sirus na n kõo noor tɩ b tɩ lebs n me Zerizalɛm tẽngã ne a wẽnd-​doogã. A Sirus sɩd kõo noor tɩ b maan woto bɩ? N-⁠ye, a yeela Israɛll nebã yaa: ‘Leb-⁠y Zerizalɛm masã n tɩ me yãmb Wẽnnaam a Zeova roogã.’ Wa yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã, yaa rẽ la Israɛll nebã rebd n na n tɩ maane.

La pa Israɛll neb nins fãa sẽn da be Babilonnã n da tõe n leb Zerizalɛm ye. Sorã yaa wok n ta kɩlometr kobs-​nii, neb wʋsg ra kʋʋlame tɩ kẽer yaa bãad dãmba, tɩ kɩt tɩ b pa tõog ye. Yɛl a taab me n kɩt tɩ neb kẽer pa tũ n kul ye. La a Sirus yeela neb nins sẽn da pa na n tũ n kulã yaa: ‘Bao-⁠y wanzuri ne sãnem la kũun a taab n kõ neb nins sẽn lebd n na n tɩ me Zerizalɛm ne a wẽnd-​doogã.’

B sɩd kõo neb nins sẽn da lebd Zerizalɛmmã kũun wʋsgo. A Sirus me kõ-b-⁠la Wẽnnaam doogã laasã la teed a taab nins fãa rĩm a Nebukadnezaar sẽn da wʋk Zerizalɛm sãoongã wakatã. Dẽnd nebã sẽn wa n lebdẽ wã, b zãa teed wʋsgo.

Kiis a naas poore, Israɛll nebã taa Zerizalɛm. Yʋʋm pis-​yopoe masã la tẽngã sẽn da sãamã, la ned baa a ye ra pa ket be ye. La wala d sẽn na n yã taoorã, Israɛll nebã paama zu-​loeese, baa ne b sẽn da be b ba-​yir masã wã.Ezai 44:⁠28; 45:​1-⁠4; Ɛsdras 1:​1-⁠11. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YAA sẽn ta neb tus pis-⁠nu n yi Babilon n na n leb Zerizalɛmmã. La b ta n mikame tɩ Zerizalɛm ra sãama zãnga. Ned baa a ye ra pa ket be ye. Israɛll nebã ra segd n lebs n manega bũmba fãa.

B sẽn ta wã, b pipi tʋʋmd yɩɩ tẽn-​kugrã meebo. Yaa tẽn-​kugrã zug la b yõogd rũmsã n kõt a Zeova. Kiis a wãn poore, Israɛll nebã sɩnga wẽnd-​doogã meebo. La tẽn-​yagsã neb ra pa rat tɩ b me wẽnd-​doogã ye. Rẽ n so tɩ b mak n na n yɛɛs-⁠b tɩ b yals meebã. B kɩtame meng tɩ Pɛrs rĩm-paalgã yiis noor n gɩdg Israɛll nebã tɩ b ra le me ye.

Yʋʋm 17 masã la Israɛll nebã sẽn yi Babilon n kẽng b ba-​yirã. A Zeova tʋma no-​rɛɛs a Aaze la no-​rɛɛs a Zakari tɩ b tɩ yeel nebã tɩ b lebs n sɩng wẽnd-​doogã meebo. Nebã teega Wẽnnaam n sak n maan no-​rɛɛsdbã sẽn yeelã. Baa Pɛrs rĩmã sẽn yiis noor n gɩdg tɩ b ra me wã, b lebs n sɩnga wẽnd-​doogã meebo.

La Pɛrs kug-​zĩid a ye yʋʋr sẽn boond t’a Tatenayi wa n soka Israɛll nebã tɩ ãnd n kõ-b sor tɩ b me wẽnd-​doogã. Israɛll nebã yeel-⁠a lame tɩ bãmb sẽn wa n be Babilonnã, rĩm a Sirus yeel-⁠b lame tɩ b leb Zerizalɛm n tɩ me b Wẽnnaam a Zeova roogã.

A Tatenayi toola sebr Babilon n na n sok n ges a Sirus sã n sɩd ra yeela Israɛll nebã tɩ b tɩ me wẽnd-​doogã. Rẽ poor bilfu, Pɛrs rĩm-paalgã toola sebr n wilg t’a Sirus sɩd ra yeela woto. Rẽ n so tɩ rĩm-paalgã yeel a Tatenayi t’a bas Israɛll nebã tɩ b me b wẽnd-​doogã, la a yeel t’a sõng-⁠b menga. Yʋʋm a naas loogr poore, wẽnd-​doogã me n saame tɩ Israɛll nebã sũy yaa noog wʋsgo.

B sẽn me wẽnd-​doogã n sa kaoosame masã. A rat n taa yʋʋm 48. Zerizalɛm nebã ra yaa talse, tẽngã ne wẽnd-​doogã me ra pa le yaa neer ye. A Ɛsdras zĩnda Babilon n wʋm tɩ wẽnd-​doogã rata manegre. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning bɩ?

A Ɛsdras tɩ goma ne a Artazɛgzɛs sẽn da yaa Pɛrs rĩm wakat kãnga wã, tɩ rĩmã sẽn da yaa rĩm-​sõngã kõ-a teed wʋsg t’a na n tall n kẽng Zerizalɛm. A Ɛsdras bõosa Israɛll neb nins sẽn da be Babilonnã tɩ b sõng-⁠a t’a tall kũunã n kẽng Zerizalɛm. Yaa sẽn na ta neb tus a yoob n yeel tɩ b na n tũ n kẽngame. B talla wanzuri ne sãnem la teed a taab wʋsg n looge.

La a Ɛsdras ra yɛɛsdame, bala bi-​bees n da gɩt nebã soyã zutu. B ra tõe n yõk-⁠b lame n deeg b wanzuri wã ne b sãnemã, la b kʋ-⁠ba. Rẽ n so t’a Ɛsdras tigim neba n pʋʋs a Zeova t’a kogl-⁠b tɩ b ta Zerizalɛm ne laafɩ. Yaa rẽ yĩng la yãmb sẽn ne fotã zug tɩ b pʋʋsdẽ wã.

A Zeova sɩd kogl-⁠b lame. Kiis a naas poore, b taa Zerizalɛm tɩ bũmb ka maan-⁠b ye. Woto wilgdame tɩ ned sã n kos a Zeova t’a kogl-⁠a, a tõe n sɩd kogl-⁠a lame.Ɛsdras sak a 2 n tɩ tãag a 8. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

NAND t’a Ɛsdras kẽng Zerizalɛm, bũmb n maan Pɛrs tẽngã pʋgẽ. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn maanã. A Mardose ne a Ɛstɛɛr ra yaa Israɛll neba. A Mardose ba wã ne a Ɛstɛɛr ba wã yaa saam-​biisi. A Ɛstɛɛr ra yaa na-​paga, t’a Mardose me ra tar naam. Rĩmã sẽn yãk a toogo, a Mardose n yɩɩd neb a taabã fãa. Bɩ d ges sẽn sɩng to-⁠to tɩ wa yaa woto.

A Ɛstɛɛr ba wã ne a ma wã kiime t’a ra ket n paoodẽ. Rẽ n so t’a Mardose reeg-⁠a n wubi. A Mardose ra tʋmda Pɛrs rĩm a Asierus zakẽ wã. Na-​zakã ra bee Suuzi. Raar a yembre, rĩmã pag a Vasti kɩɩsa rĩmã noore, tɩ rĩmã na n bao pag a to. Yãmb mii a sẽn yãk pag ning bɩ? Yaa pʋg-​sad-​neer a Ɛstɛɛr. Yãmb nee rao ning sẽn be fotã zug tɩ nebã wõgemd n pʋʋsd-⁠a wã bɩ? Yaa a Haman. Yaa Pɛrs tẽngã nin-​kãseng a ye, la a yaa wuk-⁠m-​meng soaba. A ratame t’a Mardose sẽn zĩ wã me wõgemd n pʋʋs-⁠a. La a Mardose pa sak n na n maan dẽ, bala a tagsdame tɩ pa zems tɩ b wõgemd n pʋʋs nin-​wẽng a woto buud ye. A Haman sũurã puugame t’a baood n na n kʋ a Mardose ne a buudã neba.

A Haman kãnega Israɛll nebã ne rĩmã n yeel tɩ b yaa nin-​wẽns sẽn pa rat n tũ rĩmã noyã, la tɩ b segd n kʋ-⁠b lame. La rĩm a Asierus ra pa mi t’a pag a Ɛstɛɛr yaa Israɛll ned ye. Rẽ n so t’a kelg a Haman goamã n yiis noor n wilg tɩ b yãka daar n na n kʋ Israɛll nebã fãa.

A Mardose sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a sũurã sãama wʋsgo. A toolame tɩ b yeel a Ɛstɛɛr t’a yõk rĩmã sɛɛg tɩ b ra kʋ-⁠b ye. Pɛrs rãmbã nengẽ, fo sã n da kẽ n na n yã rĩmã t’a pa bool foo, a sã n pa dɩk a dasaarã n tees-⁠fo, b kʋʋd-⁠f lame. La a Ɛstɛɛr kẽ n yãa rĩmã tɩ b pa bool-⁠a ye. La rĩmã rɩka a sãnem dasaarã n tees a Ɛstɛɛr n wilg tɩ b pa segd n kʋ-⁠a ye. A Ɛstɛɛr maana kibs n bool rĩmã ne a Haman. Kibsã daare, rĩmã soka a Ɛstɛɛr tɩ bõe la a rata. A Ɛstɛɛr yeela rĩmã tɩ yẽ ne a Haman wa kibs ning a sẽn na n maan vẽkembeoogã, t’a na n togs-⁠a lame.

Vẽkembeoogã, kibsã sasa, a Ɛstɛɛr yeela rĩmã yaa: ‘B rat n kʋʋ maam ne m buudã neba.’ Rĩmã sũur puugame t’a sok tɩ yaa ãnda soab la sẽn dat n maan dẽ wã.

A Ɛstɛɛr leokame yaa: ‘Yaa nin-​wẽng a Haman sẽn zĩ ka wã n dat n maan yel-​kãngã.’

Rĩmã sũur puugame n paas t’a yeel tɩ b kʋ a Haman. Yaa rẽ poor la rĩmã kõ a Mardose naamã. A Mardose kɩtame tɩ b yiis noor a to sẽn kõt Israɛll nebã sor tɩ daar ning b sẽn yãk n na n kʋ-​bã sã n ta, bɩ b zab n fãag b mense. Sẽn mik t’a Mardose lebga nin-​kãsengã yĩnga, neb wʋsg n wa n sõng Israɛll nebã tɩ b zab n tõog b bɛɛbã n paam n põse.Ɛstɛɛr sak a 1 n tɩ tãag 10. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y Israɛll nebã sẽn tʋmde. Yaa Zerizalɛm lalgã la b sẽn met woto wã. Yaa yʋʋm koabg la pis-⁠nu la a yiib masã la rĩm a Nebukadnezaar sẽn wa n sãam Zerizalɛmmã. A kɩtame tɩ b pãb lalsã n siig la b yõog kʋɩlensã. Israɛll nebã sẽn wa n yi Babilon n lebg n wa wã, b pa reng n me lalsã ye.

La nebã sẽn da vɩ tɩ lals pa gũbg b tẽngã, b ra yɛɛsdame tɩ b bɛɛbã na n wa kẽ nana-​nana n zab ne-⁠ba. La a Nehemi waame n na n sõng-⁠b tɩ b lebs n me lalsã. Yãmb mii a Nehemi sẽn yaa ned ning bɩ?

A Nehemi yaa Israɛll ned sẽn vɩ Suuz. A Mardose ne a Ɛstɛɛr me vɩɩ be. A Nehemi tʋmda na-​yirã. Dẽnd tõe tɩ yẽ ne a Mardose la na-​pag a Ɛstɛɛr mii taab sõma. La Biiblã pa wilgd a Nehemi sã n tʋm n kõo a Ɛstɛɛr sɩd a Asierus ye. A tʋmdame n kõt rĩm ning sẽn pʋgl a Asierusã. Yaa rĩm a Artazɛgzɛs.

Tẽeg-⁠y tɩ yaa rĩm-sõng a Artazɛgzɛs n da kõ a Ɛsdras ligd wʋsg t’a kẽng Zerizalɛm n tɩ maneg a Zeova roogã. La a Ɛsdras ra pa maneg lalsã sẽn da lʋɩyã ye. Bɩ d ges sẽn sɩng to-⁠to t’a Nehemi wa sõngd n met lalsã.

Yaa yʋʋm 13 masã la a Artazɛgzɛs sẽn kõ a Ɛsdras ligd t’a tɩ maneg wẽnd-​doogã. A Nehemi n lebg rĩm a Artazɛgzɛs rã-kɩta. Rat n yeelame tɩ yẽ n kõt rĩmã rãam, la a gũusdẽ tɩ ned ra wa ning tɩɩm rĩmã rãam pʋgẽ ye. Ad ra pa tʋʋm bil ye!

Raar a yembre, a Nehemi ma-​biig a Hanani ne rap a taab yii Israɛll tẽngã n na n tɩ ges a Nehemi. B togs-⁠a-⁠la Israɛll nebã zu-​loeese, la b yeel-⁠a me tɩ Zerizalɛm lalsã ket n nan pa me ye. A Nehemi sũurã sãama wʋsg t’a pʋʋs a Zeova n togs-⁠a yellã.

Daar a yembre, rĩmã gũus n gesame t’a Nehemi nengã gãnemame t’a sok-⁠a yaa: ‘Bõe n tar foo tɩ f sũurã pa noomẽ?’ A Nehemi yeelame tɩ yaa Zerizalɛm sẽn sãam tɩ lalsã lʋɩyã yĩng n kɩt t’a sũurã pa noomẽ wã. Rĩmã sok-⁠a lame tɩ bõe la a rata.

A yeela rĩmã t’a bas t’a kẽng Zerizalɛm n tɩ lebs n me lalsã. Rĩm a Artazɛgzɛs yaa nin-​sõngo. A yeela a Nehemi t’a kẽnge, la a sõng-⁠a lame meng t’a paam raad sẽn na yɩl n tɩ tʋm tʋʋmdã. A Nehemi sẽn ta Zerizalɛmmã bala, a togsa nebã yẽ sẽn wa n na n maan bũmb ninga. Nebã sũy yɩɩ noog tɩ b yeel tɩ b na n sɩnga tʋʋmdã tao-​tao. Israɛll nebã bɛɛb sẽn yã tɩ b sɩnga lalsã meebã, b yeelame tɩ b na n tɩ kʋ-⁠b lame tɩ tʋʋmdã yalse. La a Nehemi sẽn wʋm dẽ wã, a kõo tʋm-​tʋmdbã sʋʋs ne kãn la a yeel-⁠b yaa: ‘Bɩ y ra zoe bãmb ye. Zab-⁠y n fãag y saam-​biisã ne y kambã la y pagbã ne y tẽngã.’

Nebã talla raoodo. B ra zãada b zab-​teedã wakat fãa la b tʋmdẽ. Lalsã meeme n sa rasem 52 pʋgẽ bala. Masã, nebã pa le zoet rabeem ye. A Nehemi ne a Ɛsdras zãmsa nebã Wẽnnaam noyã. Nebã sũur yɩɩ noogo.

La baa ne rẽ fãa, yɛlã ra pa sõma zãng wa Israɛll nebã sẽn da nan pa kẽng yembd Babilonnã ye. Yaa Pɛrs rĩmã n da so Israɛll nebã, la b ra segd n sak-⁠a lame. La a Zeova kãabame t’a na n tʋma rĩm a to sẽn na n kɩt tɩ nebã zĩnd ne laafɩ. Rĩm-kãng yaa ãnda? Wãn to la a na n kɩt tɩ laafɩ zĩnd tẽngã zugu? Yaa yʋʋm kobs-​naas la pis-⁠nu loogr poor la b yaool n bãng rẽ fãa. Wakat kãngã, bi-​pɛɛlg n doge. La a rogmã na n waa ne bark wʋsgo. D na n wa yãa rẽ taoore.Nehemi sak a 1 n tɩ tãag a 6.
